shots.note: medium push_in: Vishnu stands calm in his golden Vaikuntha with a gold halo opening behind him as the question is asked; the title card sits above his head.
medium pull_out: Garuda spreads his red-gold wings wide and proud in a bright sky, a gold glow behind him on 'strongest', then his wings close as if the answer lies elsewhere.
insert push_in: A glowing gold amrut pot floats in a ring of soft light between golden clouds, pulsing on 'amrut'; Garuda looks up at it with devotion.
medium tilt_up: Garuda stands at full height with folded red-gold wings; on 'bird' he spreads them and a name plate 'Garuda' appears above him.
two_shot dolly_right: Vinata in a faded brown sari stands with a gentle tired smile at the left, Garuda beside her turns to her with warm eyes; her name appears on 'Vinata'.
medium push_in: Vinata kneels sad and small at the left in the shadow of two big raised cobras, one teal and one black-gold, that sway over her with forked tongues out.
two_shot dolly_left: A big teal cobra rises at the right with a cunning look toward a glowing amrut pot that appears on 'amrut', while Vinata watches hopefully at the left.
insert push_in: The amrut pot glows inside a tall ring of flames that flicker around it in a dark red heaven.
wide handheld: A wheel of steel blades spins fast in the middle of the frame with a big crowned guard serpent with glowing red eyes on each side; the guards strike on 'snakes'.
medium push_in: Garuda dives into the ring of fire with wings swept back and a fierce face; flames part around him and a white flash fills the frame on 'broke'.
medium static: Garuda hovers in the sky with the amrut pot held at his chest, eyes wide and wings stopped half open, a still frozen moment.
two_shot dolly_left: Vishnu stands calm and tall on the right in a golden glow with his hand raised; Garuda hovers small at the left holding the pot, facing him.
close push_in: A close bust of Vishnu with a knowing quiet smile and gentle eyes, a pale halo behind his head.
two_shot pull_out: Vishnu smiles warmly with open hands; Garuda stands before him humbly with the full amrut pot untouched at his chest.
medium tilt_up: Vishnu holds out his open hand toward the viewer with a warm smile and a ray of light falling from it.
medium push_in: Garuda folds his hands in a humble namaste with wings folded, looking up with devotion as two small gold lights appear beside him.
two_shot static: Stacked, Garuda hovers in the top half with wings spread and Vishnu stands in the bottom half looking up at him, so Garuda is literally above Vishnu.
medium push_in: Garuda glows with a bright gold aura and a calm strong smile; his wings are half open and radiant light rays fan out behind him.
two_shot dolly_right: Garuda turns his head away from the glowing amrut pot with calm eyes, refusing it while the pot glows quietly at the right.
medium pull_out: Vishnu smiles with a clear nod and an open palm; a soft gold glow shows his yes.
two_shot dolly_left: Vishnu points toward Garuda, who stands at the right with wings half open and listens with a serious face; a gold line of light joins them.
medium push_in: Garuda in his carry pose with strong arms ready and wings half raised, and the word 'Vahana' appears above him on 'vahana'.
medium tilt_up: Indra stands among storm clouds in his crown with a dark angry face and the Vajra in his raised hand, lightning flickering behind him.
medium handheld: Indra throws his arm forward at the left with a roaring face while the Vajra flies away from his hand in a streak of lightning toward the right.

medium push_in: Garuda hovers calm in the storm sky, wings spread; the thrown Vajra streaks in from the left and a white flash bursts on 'Garuda', then one golden feather drifts down and he looks at it unhurt.
medium pan_left: Indra, with wide eyes and lowered Vajra, steps back out of the way to the left and looks at Garuda with respect.
medium tilt_down: Garuda gently sets the glowing amrut pot on the ground in front of him while two cobras rise watchfully at the right.
two_shot push_in: Vinata smiles with joy and presses her hands together while Garuda stands beside her with a happy face; a warm gold glow lights them both.
two_shot dolly_right: Garuda bows with folded hands before Vishnu, who stands tall in golden light on the right; his wings are folded in respect.
two_shot pull_out: Vishnu points a hand of blessing at Garuda, who spreads his wings proudly beside him; light rays open behind both.
medium push_in: Garuda flies high in glory with wings wide and a proud face under rays of light, and the word 'Vahana' appears above him.
medium dolly_right: Garuda holds the glowing amrut pot at his chest and looks gently away from it with a faint loving smile, thinking of his mother.
two_shot pull_out: Garuda bows his head with folded hands before smiling Vishnu; a gold glow and drifting petals close the story.
